remarks: Schedule your viewing today! "The Common" in Lockport offers an attractive option for those seeking low-maintenance living. This condo provides convenient access to amenities. Situated on the front row (second unit from the end), the property boasts excellent views of the gazebo and open space. Gleaming hardwood floors throughout facilitate easy maintenance. A fireplace serves as a focal point in the open-concept living and dining area. Access to a private yard is provided via a patio door. The flexible layout includes a kitchen featuring hardwood cabinets and a built-in buffet. The well-designed kitchen offers ample cabinet storage and counter space. A convenient half bath is located on the first floor. The property features two spacious bedrooms, each equipped with California closet systems. The full basement includes new luxury vinyl flooring in the recreation room. A wet bar enhances the space for gatherings. New stairs lead to the private yard. The property includes a 2.5-car garage with a workbench and storage units.
